falsifiability.H: Within 4TB, original compact specialization and unique learned outcomes outperform broad generic/quantization duplication in reproducibility and useful capability.
falsifiability.T: Reconcile all 59 next-wave IDs against 22 prior verified IDs, select first 11 and freeze all sha256+dependencies. Later matched hardware/backend/context/batch >=30 held-out tasks. Stop on rights, gated, missing total, SHA or storage mismatch.
falsifiability.D: PASS_METADATA iff 59=54 remaining+5 reported verified, no duplicate next-wave transfer, 201 unique catalog and approved queue empty; runtime quality and owner actual disk UNCERTAIN.
falsifiability.C: Large model shows unique non-overlapping task that small cannot reproduce, or authors offer complete original checkpoint and superior permissions.
falsifiability.U: Ledger source is self-report not independent D-volume hash; unknown external learned dependencies, missing revision source hash per next-wave file, market policies uncertain; u_c/k not estimable until measured trials.
